system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Lifestyle/exposure variables precede diseases; tuberculosis and lung cancer are upstream causes of the aggregate diagnosis. Bronchitis and the combined disease status can contribute to symptoms and test findings. Positive X-ray is a downstream measurement, while dyspnoea is a symptom likely appearing after disease onset.
